rule: SOURCE claim must have a source reference and quotation.
Synthetic case is off unless explicitly enabled.
Meaning-preserving conditions travel with the selected claim.
Every page has one primary message and a presentation question.
Title strength must not exceed supporting claims.
Composed relationships are SYNTHESIS unless a source states the relation.
RED data requires value, unit, metric, population, timeframe and source.
RED SYNTHESIS, conflict, or incomplete condition relationship requires human review.
Exact thresholds, doses and CIs cannot be generated as uncontrolled image text.
Protected semantic layer cannot be repainted by a generative renderer.
Public output is blocked by unresolved privacy, promotional or treatment-claim risks.
Cross-source conflicts are isolated and cannot enter delivery unresolved.
An agent may write only resources explicitly declared in its capability matrix.
A model-selected composition cannot reorder the approved narrative: the rendered visual reading order must equal the page's approved Claim order.
FOCUS_EVIDENCE leads with the page's first approved Claim; promoting a later Claim is a narrative decision that belongs upstream, not in the layout.
Text capacity is measured against the insets the delivered text frame actually receives, never the declared box.
Packaging fails closed when the Artifact Tool runtime cannot be linked; a node_modules path that does not resolve the package is not a usable build.
A semantic act may leave the machine only when the engine is qualified for that capability in the version-controlled registry and the project declares the matching egress policy.
Model-produced semantic output is validated by deterministic code before it is written; the model never grades itself and never sets risk, numeric facts, budget or ids.
A configured but unqualified or unpermitted model route fails the stage; it must not silently degrade into the deterministic engine and hide the refusal.

A reading artifact attaches only after its own gate passes: full-text read, model-derived structure, complete and unique block coverage, declared narrative order, page reason and figure intent, and declared gaps for any failing check.
An approved Claim the accepted reading never reached, and a reading page that maps to no approved Claim, are reported as allocation gaps; neither is dropped silently.
When a reading artifact is attached, the page set, page order and per-page Claim order come from that artifact and are recorded on the PageSpec; the design layer may not re-derive or reorder them.

A reading must account for every source unit: each is either backed by at least one quote-grounded candidate, or declined with a reason from a closed list. A unit the code classifies as carrying content may not be declined.

Every meaning-critical value a unit states (threshold, unit-bearing measurement, magnitude) must be covered by an accepted candidate's own words or excluded with a stated reason. Thresholds may not be excluded.
